Targeted revision of Shen Yueling turnaround. Built-in image generation, two successive edits.

Pass 1
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: revised game character turnaround sheet for the existing artbook webpage
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the existing Shen Yueling three-view sheet. Image 2 is the unchanged Lin Si comparison reference for shared scale, baseline, and facial difference. Edit only Image 1's character design.
Primary request: Revise Shen Yueling's facial anatomy and stature across all THREE orthographic views while preserving her identity, costume, equipment, color palette, three-view composition, background, sharp hand-crafted 1990s arcade pixel-art concept style, and natural standing pose. She is 16, a capable Ming fleet sailor disguised as a boy, and should read as a young woman with a clean, gently feminine face, never a child.
Face changes: replace her current wide square masculine face with a visibly narrower, softly tapered oval face. Rounded cheeks, narrower lower jaw, small soft rounded chin, no sharp point. Keep natural dark eyes but make them slightly more open and almond-shaped than Lin Si's, with softer downward outer corners and discreet highlights. Fine gently arched brows with less heavy brow bone. Smaller quieter nose and mouth. In side profile, the forehead, cheek, jawline and rounded smaller chin must reflect the same oval facial structure. In front view, even if hair and clothing were hidden, the narrower face and different brow/eye geometry must distinguish her from Lin Si. No lashes, makeup, jewellery or modern adornment.
Height and body changes: these sheets use the SAME 1536x1024 page, SAME implicit horizontal ground at approximately y=1004, SAME standing pose and SAME visual scale. Lin Si in Image 2 reaches approximately y=12 at the top and y=1004 at the shoe soles. Shen Yueling must reach approximately y=73 at the top and y=1004 at the shoe soles, about 6% shorter by occupied body height. Achieve this through a slightly lower crown and shoulder line, mildly narrower shoulders, naturally shorter torso AND slightly shorter legs, not by tiny chibi proportions or uniformly shrinking an existing picture. All three views must have matching crown y and sole y. Her body remains athletic and functional with the same head-to-body style and relatively normal proportions.
Preserve from Image 1: exactly three views in the same left/front, center/left-profile, right/back positions, each equally sized; black hair in a small topknot with red headband and rear tails; sea-teal cross collar rolled-sleeve short jacket; red waist sash; hemp rope loop visibly on her left hip (viewer right in front view, viewer left in back view); loose dark navy trousers; pale calf wraps; dark cloth shoes. Keep the seam and silhouette language and exact neutral cream background. Complete bodies with feet visible.
Constraints: revise only Shen Yueling, do not place Lin Si into the result. No labels, lettering, diagrams, borders, cards, halos, graphics, added equipment or watermark. No helmet, no armor, no modern weapon. Match the crisp block shading and pixelated black outline of the source artwork.

Pass 2
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: final Shen Yueling three-view character sheet adjustment
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET with the newly corrected soft oval face and complete existing costume. Image 2 is Lin Si solely as an unchanged same-scale height reference.
Primary request: Preserve the new feminine-but-capable face of Image 1 EXACTLY: softly tapered oval cheeks, rounded narrow chin, fine arched brows, gentle almond eyes, small natural nose and mouth. Preserve all clothing, topknot and red headband, teal cross collar rolled-sleeve jacket, red sash, left hip rope loops, navy pants, wrapped calves and cloth shoes, same color and pixel art style. Make ONLY a final height/proportion adjustment to Yueling on the SAME 1536x1024 neutral cream turnaround page, still exact front, left profile, back views in the same three columns with the same natural stance and same floor line.
Height calibration: Image 2 Lin Si occupies y=12 through y=1006, height 995 px. Yueling should occupy y=76 through y=1006, height 931 px, meaning 6.4% shorter than Lin Si. The current Image 1 occupies y=57 through y=1005, height 949 px, so make her about 18 pixels shorter overall through a slightly lower head top, a lower and narrower shoulder line, and a little shorter legs and torso. Do not simply scale a complete cutout. All three Yueling views should have matching top around y=76 and matching shoe sole baseline around y=1005. Her head size must remain natural. Keep Image 1's corrected face clearly distinct from Lin Si's squarer, heavier-browed face.
Constraints: No Lin Si in result. No added text, labels, background decoration, halos, cards, props, watermark, makeup, lash emphasis, chibi proportions or action poses. Preserve sharp hand-placed arcade pixel clusters and black contour.
